title: Melody Ranch
paragraphs: Gene Autry western musical-variety series combining songs, comedy and a dramatic Western segment.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Pilot (December 31, 1939 to December 31, 1939) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], First CBS run (January 7, 1940 to August 1, 1943) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], Postwar 15-minute return (September 23, 1945 to June 16, 1946) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and Postwar 30-minute run (June 17, 1946 to December 31, 1955) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Gene Autry (performer), Johnny Bond (performer), The Cass County Boys (performer), The King Sisters (performer), William Burch (director), Carl Cotner and His Orchestra (performer), and Carl Cotner (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

The stories often return to country-western and cowboy music, Western adventure and ranch storytelling, Gene Autry career interview and retrospective, Melody Roundup / AFRS country-western programming, religious and inspirational music, and Christmas and holiday programming.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Wartime interruption and Gene Autry’s Army Air Forces service, CBS commercial Western-variety sponsorship, Singing-cowboy popular culture, and Post-series Gene Autry retrospective archive.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|barrie-craig|Barrie Craig]], [[show|boston-blackie|Boston Blackie]], [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]], [[show|sears-radio-theater|Sears Radio Theater]], and [[show|the-adventures-of-the-thin-man|The Adventures of the Thin Man]].
